heading: Dallas
description: A map of the City of Dallas with toggleable layers: eleven areas built from ZIP codes, known-as names, council districts, Texas House and Senate and congressional districts, counties, main streets, highways, DART light rail, and where to vote on November 3.

living.caveat: Survey estimates for 2020–2024, not current prices, for the whole ZIP code (including any part outside Dallas). Rent is what renting households pay, utilities included, counting long-time tenants and subsidized homes, so it sits below what a new lease costs. Use them to compare ZIP codes, not to budget.
